Our philosophy

A photograph isn't just something you look at. It's something that takes you back.

How we work

We direct. We don't pose.

A little guidance on light and where to stand, then we step back. The expressions are yours, not ours.

The best frame is usually the one after.

After the kiss, after the toast, after everyone thinks we've stopped. That's when people stop performing.

Fewer days, full attention.

We photograph around thirty weddings a year. The person you meet at the first coffee is the person behind the camera on the day.
